In the Junior 10 miles Championship at Hampstead in 1938 when, let us remember, we had a record winning score with Len and Joe Coleman dead-heating for first place, Colin Sutton 6th and Reg Elson 7th, Doub finished 24th of the 127 finishers.
A welcome spectator at the Club 20 miles walking championship was REG. ELSON who joined us in the late twenties and was a regular member of our walking teams for a number of years.

In 1938 he dead-heated with brother Joe to win the National Junior 10 Miles (Garret Cup) Championship and with Colin Sutton (who was murdered by terrorists in Malaya) and Reg Elson to win the team title with a record breaking 16 points.
We have lost another of our stalwarts of bygone years. R.F. (Reg.) Elson died recently at the age of 78.
